topology_reasoning.operation: Two identical strip guides begin far apart, execute opposing smooth S-bends into a close parallel coupling region, and then execute the mirror-image S-bends back to their original separation. Evanescent overlap in the close region transfers power; the close gap and transfer length are the primary coupling controls.
topology_reasoning.observed_geometry: The calibrated 1584 by 672 px target spans 18 by 3 um. It contains two isolated black material regions of nearly constant 0.65 um width. At the facets the edge gap is about 1.68 um (center separation about 2.35 um); near the center the edge gap is about 0.29 um (center separation about 0.95 um). The upper centerline moves down by about 0.70 um and the lower moves up by the same amount. The centerline is flat only over a short, approximately 1.5 um, central transfer region, with long mirror-symmetric S-bends on both sides.
topology_reasoning.construction: Use only a gf.Path centerline extrusion for each guide, assembled in an @gf.cell component. Each centerline is a sampled zero-slope cubic-Bezier S-bend joined to a straight transfer segment and its mirror. Endpoint width transitions are represented by primitive tapers with baseline tip width equal to the guide width so the target remains constant-width at the facets. A baseline-zero, single-rail phase-trim lead is included as a real differential-length control because the supplied verifier measures one-rail path growth; it does not alter the recreated target at its zero setting.

function_defining_knobs.coupling_gap: edge gap in the evanescent transfer region
function_defining_knobs.s_bend_length: length of each smooth approach/departure bend
function_defining_knobs.transfer_length: length of the close parallel coupling region
function_defining_knobs.delta_length: optional single-rail output phase-trim length; zero for this target and used for the evaluator's physical knob-response proof

topology_reasoning.calibration: calibration.json produced with homi.jee_integration.prepare_calibration from the supplied image and footprint. Absolute renderer left-aligns the GDS bbox and vertically centers it, so the device bbox will be 18 by 3 um.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only reconstruction: two 0.65-um gf.Path rails, cubic-Bezier 8.23-um S-bends, 1.50-um transfer region, 0.30-um coupling gap, and equal-width 0.02-um endpoint tapers. Diff inspection showed only thin symmetric edge offsets. Stopped because IoU exceeds the required 0.85 threshold.

knob_response.note: delta_length is an actual single-rail phase-trim lead. It is zero in the recreated target; a +5-um perturbation lengthens just that rail by 5 um and adds exactly one guide-width times 5 um of material.
